description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to the DeleteFeatureProperties command within a live signal processing context. It provides factory interfaces for generating response objects and event objects tied to the command execution outcomes.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command responses and events for DeleteFeatureProperties operations in a live signal context.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating response objects such as successful deletion responses and error responses related to feature properties.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating event objects such as FeaturePropertiesDeleted events triggered by the delete command.
